description: Find CFTC Commitment of Traders (COT) futures markets by name. Use this first to get the exact market_and_exchange_names and contract_code that latest_report and report_history require. Keyless. e.g. "crude oil", "gold", "E-MINI S&P", "bitcoin", "euro", "corn".

limit.description: Max distinct markets to return (default 15, max 30).

query.description: Substring to match against the market name, e.g. "crude oil", "gold", "E-MINI S&P", "bitcoin", "euro".

name: search_markets
title: Search Markets
